answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward a new identity earns stays locked for a 30-epoch voyage before it can be spent or moved. If peers later flag the account as part of a kin cluster, that locked plume of unvested rewards is slashed. An attacker spinning up 1,000 fake agents must fund each one's compute for the whole lockup with no liquid return, and a single detection gale wipes the batch's escrow, so expected profit turns negative.
